title: Perfect charts over the actual unlifted Padic coefficient datum
statement: Let T be a noetherian scheme of bounded Krull dimension, let l be prime and invertible in every stalk of T, and let E/Q_l be a finite extension in the coefficient universe [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put d=pbcPadicCoefficientDatum(l,E), with the actual unlifted valuation ring, and B=pbcAdicCompletion(T,d) [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For every bounded constructible intrinsically complete K [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], there are a finite stratification S and pro-etale covers V_a of its strata, such that for every chart g:V_aj -> T there is a perfect complex C of modules over O_E [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. The exact derived pullback of K along g is isomorphic to that of integralConstantDerived(T,d)(C), both with the actual inverse-image B coefficients [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models]. No torsion decomposition or Tor calculation is asserted.

proof.text: Choose coordinates in a finite Q_l-basis of E. The image of the coordinate map is a field in the smaller universe, algebraically isomorphic to E. The unique extended absolute value identifies valuation rings. The two uniformizers generate corresponding maximal ideals, so every ideal power and quotient diagram corresponds even if the uniformizers themselves differ by units. Exact scalar equivalences identify completed coefficient sheaves, reduction functors, completion units, uniform local models and compatible etale origins. Stalkwise inverses of l glue uniquely to a global inverse. Apply the existing integral stratified-perfect characterization and transport its perfect values back along the valuation-ring equivalence.

Choose a covering family generating each covering sieve of a stratum. Identify slice sites at these weakly etale objects with the pro-etale sites of the covering schemes. The exact module equivalences and inverse-image composition identify the slice-derived local isomorphisms with the displayed pullbacks along the composite chart maps. Immersion inverse image preserves completed coefficients; the constant finite-complex realization identifies the transported model with the actual unlifted integralConstantDerived model. Empty strata are permitted.

theorem pbc_adic_unlifted_perfect_charts
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (hl : ∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)) :
    let d := pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E
    let B := pbcAdicCompletion T d
    ∃ (S : Stratification T)
      (V : ∀ a : Fin S.n, Cover.{u + 1} proetalePrecoverage (S.domain a)),
      ∀ (a : Fin S.n) (j : (V a).I₀),
        let g := (V a).f j ≫ S.immersion a
        ∃ C : completedConstantDerived
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)),
          @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) C ∧
          Nonempty ((adicTowerPullback g B).obj K.obj ≅
            (adicTowerPullback g B).obj ((integralConstantDerived T d).obj C))
